inject money into: The government plans to inject money into small businesses that were badly hurt by the long economic slowdown.
政府計畫注資給在長期經濟衰退中受到重創的小型企業。
inject humor into: Our history teacher likes to inject humor into her lessons, so even the sleepiest students stay awake.
我們的歷史老師喜歡在課堂中注入幽默，所以連最想睡的學生都保持清醒。
inject new life: The young manager hopes to inject new life into the old bookstore by adding a café and weekend events.
年輕的經理希望藉由增設咖啡館和週末活動，為這家老書店注入新活力。
inject a vaccine: The nurse cleaned the girl's arm carefully before she began to inject a vaccine against the flu.
護士在開始注射流感疫苗之前，仔細地清潔了女孩的手臂。
inject energy into: The new coach managed to inject energy into the tired team, and they won three games in a row.
新教練成功地為疲憊的球隊注入活力，他們接連贏了三場比賽。
injure one's pride: Losing the final match to a much younger player seemed to injure his pride more than his body.
在決賽中輸給一位年輕許多的選手，似乎傷了他的自尊，更甚於傷了他的身體。
be seriously injured: Two passengers were seriously injured when the bus slid off the wet road during the heavy storm.
在大暴雨中巴士滑出濕滑的路面時，有兩名乘客受了重傷。
injure one's reputation: Spreading false rumors online can injure one's reputation for years, even after the truth comes out.
在網路上散布不實謠言可能會損害一個人的名譽長達數年，即使真相大白之後也一樣。
input data: Every evening, the clerk has to input data from the day's sales into the store's computer system.
每天晚上，店員都必須把當天的銷售資料輸入商店的電腦系統。
input one's password: For your safety, you will need to input your password again before you can change any account settings.
為了您的安全，您在變更任何帳戶設定之前，需要再次輸入密碼。
value your input: We really value your input, so please tell us honestly what you think of the new school menu.
我們非常重視你的意見，所以請誠實告訴我們你對新學校菜單的看法。
insert a coin: To get a drink from this old machine, you have to insert a coin and then press the button firmly.
要從這台舊機器買飲料，你必須投幣，然後用力按下按鈕。
insert a clause: Before signing the contract, our lawyer asked the company to insert a clause about overtime pay.
在簽約之前，我們的律師要求公司加入一項關於加班費的條款。
insert a comment: When you review your classmate's essay online, you can insert a comment next to any sentence that seems unclear.
當你在線上批改同學的作文時，可以在任何看起來不清楚的句子旁插入評論。
inspect the troops: On National Day, the president will inspect the troops standing in neat lines in front of the hall.
在國慶日當天，總統將校閱在大廳前排列整齊的部隊。
inspect the goods: Before you sign for the delivery, you should inspect the goods carefully to make sure nothing is broken.
在你簽收貨物之前，應該仔細檢查貨物，確保沒有任何東西破損。
inspect the site: After the earthquake, engineers came to inspect the site to decide whether the building was still safe.
地震過後，工程師前來勘查現場，以判斷這棟建築是否仍然安全。
inspect a document: The customs officer took a long time to inspect a document that the traveler had brought from abroad.
海關人員花了很長的時間審視那名旅客從國外帶來的一份文件。
inspire confidence: A doctor who explains things calmly and clearly can inspire confidence in nervous patients and their families.
一位冷靜清楚地說明病情的醫生，能夠激發緊張的病患和家屬的信心。
inspire a generation: Her brave speech about climate change helped inspire a generation of young people to take action.
她關於氣候變遷的勇敢演說啟發了一代年輕人採取行動。
be inspired by: Many famous painters were inspired by the beautiful light and colors of the small seaside village.
許多知名畫家都受到這個海邊小村莊美麗光線與色彩的啟發。
inspire fear: The dark, empty hallway and strange noises in the old hospital were enough to inspire fear in every visitor.
那座老醫院裡陰暗空蕩的走廊和奇怪的聲響，足以讓每位訪客心生恐懼。
inspire loyalty: A leader who treats workers fairly and listens to them will inspire loyalty that lasts for many years.
一位公平對待員工並傾聽他們心聲的領導者，將會贏得持續多年的忠誠。
install software: You need to ask the IT department for permission before you install software on any school computer.
在任何學校電腦上安裝軟體之前，你必須先徵求資訊部門的許可。
install a new manager: After sales dropped for two years, the owners decided to install a new manager at the hotel.
在銷售額連續兩年下滑後，業主決定任命一位新經理來管理這家飯店。
install oneself in a chair: Grandpa likes to install himself in a chair by the window and read the newspaper all morning.
爺爺喜歡在窗邊的椅子上坐定，整個早上都在看報紙。
install security cameras: After several bikes were stolen, the school decided to install security cameras near the parking area.
在數輛腳踏車被偷之後，學校決定在停車區附近裝設監視器。
institute reforms: The new minister promised to institute reforms that would reduce the heavy pressure of exams on students.
新任部長承諾實施改革，以減輕考試加諸學生身上的沉重壓力。
institute legal proceedings: If the company refuses to pay for the damage, the family will institute legal proceedings against it next month.
如果公司拒絕賠償損失，這家人下個月將對其提起訴訟。
institute a policy: The city decided to institute a policy that bans plastic bags in all supermarkets starting next year.
市政府決定制定一項政策，從明年起禁止所有超市使用塑膠袋。
